d:
WHAT IF WE TAKE PROTEIN OUT OF THE GYM AND BRING IT TO THE STREETS OF INDIA?
For the first time, we brought the concept of a PROTEIN SHABEEL to the general public!
More than 5,000 people came forward to taste protein drinks in this unique initiative. From fitness enthusiasts to ordinary people, everyone got an opportunity to experience protein nutrition.
Our mission is simple: FITNESS AND NUTRITION SHOULD NOT BE LIMITED TO GYMS.
Protein is an essential part of a balanced diet, and awareness about protein consumption needs to reach every household in India.
